title: The SVP — A Departure in the Style of The Jerk

lines.speaker: NAVIN
lines.text: The new SVP needs nothing from this place. Nothing at all! Except this degree.

lines.speaker: NAVIN
lines.text: The degree is the only thing I need. The degree... and Darla. The degree and Darla — that's all I need.

lines.speaker: NAVIN
lines.text: And the Hoosier guy. The degree, Darla, and the Hoosier guy. That's all I need.

lines.speaker: NAVIN
lines.text: And the telescope. The degree, Darla, the Hoosier guy, and the telescope from Afghanistan.

lines.speaker: NAVIN
lines.text: And this piece of wire! The degree, Darla, the Hoosier guy, the telescope, and this piece of wire — that's all I need!

lines.speaker: NAVIN
lines.text: I don't need this EBITDA bridge. I don't need the phantom hundred-and-fifty-million-dollar municipal pipeline. I don't need these COOs they parachuted onto the weakest divisions!

lines.speaker: NAVIN
lines.text: I don't need the Class B equity — well... I never had the Class B equity. That's the whole point.

lines.speaker: NAVIN
lines.text: Darla, the degree, the Hoosier guy, the telescope, AND the wire! That's the only stuff I need! I don't need anything el—

lines.speaker: NAVIN
lines.text: ...and the reef tank. The degree, Darla, the Hoosier guy, the telescope, the wire, and the reef tank. But that's it. That's all I need.

lines.speaker: NAVIN
lines.text: ...I might need a Red Sea Reefer four-fifty to hold the reef tank. But that's a separate conversation.
